validation_methodology.window: 60d x 15m (Yahoo Finance), OOS days after 10-day warmup for TOD RVOL & ER
validation_methodology.spread_and_slippage_model: 0.38% of Mini certificate equity + 0.02 SEK slippage (+19 SEK courtage if <1,000 SEK)
validation_methodology.caveat: Honest empirical sample (n=37 global trades over 50 OOS days) yields PSR=87.1% and low CSCV PBO=20.0%, but DSR=30.9% (<90%) because MinTRL=155 trades is not yet reached; enforce strict 450 SEK 1R risk parity.

NVDA.preferred_regime_strategy: LOW_SAMPLE_HIGH_BETA (60d down -29.6%; prioritize bidirectional MINI S in downtrends, avoid ORB chase)
key_learned_rules: 60d IMOM OOS evidence: 4W/6L (WR=40.0%, PF=0.54, Net=-495.8 SEK). Below MinTRL (10/1036 trades; DSR=1.3%, Wilson 95% LB=16.8%).
Only enter leveraged Mini breakouts/continuations when 5-day Kaufman ER >= 0.28 and Time-of-Day RVOL >= 1.05; afternoon IMOM outperformed unconditional ORB.
Hold uncapped winners with +0.85R -> +0.15R BE ratchet; require BOTH EMA4 failure AND VWAP breakdown before auto-exiting.
